quarterly_data.quarter: AIXTRON press release: Strong momentum in optoelectronics continues (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 order intake EUR 386.0 million, 54% above the prior year (H1/2025: EUR 250.7 million), with optoelectronics about 75% of Q2 equipment order intake. Equipment order backlog stood at EUR 456.9 million as of June 30, 2026, up from EUR 284.6 million a year earlier and EUR 257.8 million at end-2025. Major laser system shipments are expected to begin in Q3/2026 and continue well beyond the current fiscal year; the company says its project pipeline extends well beyond 2026. H1 free cash flow EUR 162.1 million, driven primarily by higher customer advance payments.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 order intake EUR 386.0 million (+54%); equipment backlog EUR 456.9 million at June 30, 2026 (EUR 257.8 million end-2025); H1 free cash flow EUR 162.1 million
